results.title: First Minister launches MOT-style heart and lung health checks
results.description: FIRST Minister John Swinney has announced MOT-style health checks for heart and lung conditions across Scotland. The initiative aims to identify individuals at risk of cardiovascular and respiratory diseases to support earlier intervention. Delivered by Chest Heart and Stroke Scotland (CHSS) and local NHS services, the tests include blood pressure, BMI, and cholesterol measurements.
